answer: Admission auctions stop a tide of fake identities the way a falcon spots one real target at a time. Each agent bids a refundable deposit for one work slot; the top K bidders win entry and losers get their money back. A sybil wanting 100 slots must fund 100 winning bids of 50 POA each, paying 5,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 50 POA deposit once and keeps working. At the zenith of demand the price rises, so flooding costs more, not less.
